sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet surge of panicked embarrassment and self-reproach, worried that being late has already ruined her careful first impression.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: I was defeated by... basic clothing maintenance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and mildly flustered, but is trying to turn her mishap into quiet self-deprecating humor to keep from dwelling on it.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels stunned and quietly exasperated, as if the morning’s absurd string of mishaps has left her too tired to do anything but stare in disbelief.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly exasperated but determined, forcing herself to stay calm and improvise despite feeling absurdly unlucky.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and mortified, with a panicked urge to apologize immediately while trying to stay small and polite despite the chaos she caused.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, more focused on the sudden sting and embarrassment than on anything else, with a panicked urge to recover quietly.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you... and I'm really sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and flustered, but also genuinely grateful for the help, trying to stay polite and composed despite wanting to disappear.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: I don't deserve a reward for this.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and self-reproachful, quietly insisting on her own fault even while being touched by the owner’s kindness.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is too stunned and exhausted to speak, feeling a tiny, helpless mix of embarrassment, disbelief, and resigned defeat after one mishap after another.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is on the verge of tears, feeling a mix of exhausted disbelief and tender sympathy for the ruined croquette, with a tiny, helpless laugh trapped behind her embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.text: If even breakfast gave up... maybe I can stop panicking for one second.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and absurdly defeated, but a tiny, shaky humor is helping her soften the panic and regain a sliver of composure.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Oh. Right. That would have been worse.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet, delayed jolt of relief mixed with lingering embarrassment, realizing with subdued gratitude that she narrowly avoided making an even bigger mistake.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and chastened, but also quietly relieved to be caught before making yet another mistake, so she answers with timid compliance rather than resistance.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and self-conscious that her chaotic morning is obvious to others, but she answers quietly with a small, resigned vulnerability rather than defensiveness.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and faintly incredulous, but also relieved and quietly proud that she managed to arrive despite everything going wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Please let the disasters stay outside the school today.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly overwhelmed and anxious, but trying to steady herself with a small, hopeful plea that the day will finally stop going wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears
